subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should arbitrary message-log JSONL become a supported builtin memorySearch.extraPaths format, or remain an external conversion/plugin concern?
rationale: The choice defines a new structured-data and privacy contract, including which fields become searchable, how malformed or oversized records behave, and whether raw channel logs belong in builtin memory.

options.title: Keep structured logs external
options.body: Retain Markdown/session-specific builtin contracts and document a converter, QMD, or plugin path for arbitrary JSONL ingestion.

options.title: Adopt builtin JSONL
options.body: Define a narrow supported schema and implement bounded parsing, indexing, watching, retrieval, privacy guidance, and upgrade-safe tests across the full memory surface.

recommendation.title: Keep structured logs external
recommendation.body: Retain Markdown/session-specific builtin contracts and document a converter, QMD, or plugin path for arbitrary JSONL ingestion.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to the current memory implementation and already identified the unresolved builtin-versus-alternative product choice in this issue.
